members.title: Nvidia board reportedly meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s future as chip giant’s share price plunges – follow live
members.lead: Huang’s potential departure would leave a leadership vacuum at the roughly $4tn chipmaker he co-founded, with Nvidia’s shares sliding about 8% in ​after-hours trading Donald Trump said on Monday he was “amazed” after the revelations concerning Jensen Huang – one of his ⁠closest allies in Silicon Valley – came to light. The president’s close ties with the Nvidia CEO have come under renewed scrutiny after revelations about the billionaire executive’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy were revealed. Trump said on 9 November that Huang had told him he had no idea that the woman was a spy. The president added that he believed the CEO. I asked him that question ’Did you have any idea that she was a spy?’ He said ’I had no idea that she was a spy’ and I really believe him.” I know the FBI is looking into it … I think that he’ll be in good shape.” Continue reading...

members.title: Nvidia board reportedly deciding whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang as stock price plunges
members.lead: The meeting comes after the executive and co-founder admitted to having a romantic relationship with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy Nvidia’s board of directors met on Wednesday to decide whether to oust Jensen Huang as CEO of the world’s most valuable chip company, according to multiple reports, after a tumultuous week in which the executive and co-founder of the company admitted to having a romantic relationship with a woman who is alleged to be a Chinese spy. The meeting marks ⁠a sharp shift from Sunday, when Nvidia’s board ​expressed confidence in Huang and his leadership team, and the company’s stock slid more than 8% in after-hours trading after the Wall Street Journal reported that ⁠the company was preparing to fire Huang.
